definitions.explanation: A government-mandated insurance system that provides coverage for health care, pensions, unemployment, and work-related injuries. In Japan, employers and employees share the premiums.

⟦パート→パート：03106_paato⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{条件|じょうけん}→条件：03285_jouken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{満|み}たせば→満たす：09889_mitasu⟧{社会|しゃかい}{保険|ほけん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}れる→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: Even part-time workers can enroll in social insurance if they meet the conditions.

notes:
USAGE:
Japan's social insurance ({社会|しゃかい}{保険|ほけん}) broadly covers ⟦{健康|けんこう}{保険|ほけん}→健康保険：18475_kenkouhoken⟧ (health insurance), {厚生|こうせい}⟦{年金|ねんきん}→年金：04695_nenkin⟧ (employees' pension), ⟦{雇用|こよう}→雇用：04840_koyou⟧⟦{保険|ほけん}→保険：01509_hoken⟧ (unemployment insurance), and {労災|ろうさい}⟦{保険|ほけん}→保険：01509_hoken⟧ (workers' compensation). Often abbreviated to {社保|しゃほ} in casual speech.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {社会|しゃかい}{保険|ほけん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{加入|かにゅう}する→加入する：22671_kanyuusuru⟧ (to enroll in social insurance)
- {社会|しゃかい}{保険|ほけん}{料|りょう} (social insurance premiums)
- {社会|しゃかい}{保険|ほけん}{完備|かんび} (full social insurance coverage — seen in job listings)
- {社会|しゃかい}{保険|ほけん}{制度|せいど} (social insurance system)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{国民|こくみん}{健康|けんこう}{保険|ほけん}→国民健康保険：24671_kokuminkenkouhoken⟧: National Health Insurance — for self-employed and others not covered by employer insurance
- ⟦{生命|せいめい}{保険|ほけん}→生命保険：18637_seimeihoken⟧: life insurance — private, not government-mandated
